decisions.decision: Decide all three for Adi, record them on T-488 and close it as done. Then apply them on T-484 and its docs. (1) KPI set: YRR, re-registrations and new subscribers. This matches the LOCKED FACTS and the live d3-kpis card. Opens are never a KPI. The referral ask stays a weekly action in the loop, not a KPI. Stage 6 YRR (reference 3.11%, equations.md) does show on the dashboard. (2) Path tags stay path-pro (Pro or Scale), path-course, path-enterprise and path-not-yet. (3) The re-invite tag becomes the slug '52-week-nurture', which matches the lowercase hyphenated canonical tags (registered, no-show, depth-25). A tag with a space breaks CRM filters. Put these names in d3-reinvite, D3.20, d3-kpis, the funnel Worker tagging and the starter CRM. Mark items 2 to 4 of DECISIONS_FOR_ADI.md 'decided'. Rebuild the deck, run the probes, commit, push series-deck-finish and deploy the centre. Add a line on T-484 for Adi to review.
